rites.name: Tistium
rites.text: A burst of bodily power that lets certain creatures spring across open ground in a single bound. It is shared by two kinds of hunting beings.

rites.name: Vernor
rites.text: Vernor is the concept of the Singing in Toraizhoth, the undated sounding by which the first roots of the world condensed during the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders. It names the moment matter agreed to hold its shape and is remembered in the hymns of every order.

rites.name: Ninterium
rites.text: A deadly toxin carried in the hooked tips of a creature's limbs, delivered through a scratch that poisons whoever it strikes. It belongs to the savage hunters that stalk the wilds.

rites.name: Corelia
rites.text: A fierce, close-range lunge used by a hulking warrior-beast that tramples foes who stand in its path. It lets the creature cover ground quickly and crash into enemies with brutal force.

rites.name: Leonus
rites.text: A digging operation burrows into a hollow underground chamber so that a stronghold can grow larger and house new rooms.

rites.name: Riasollor
rites.text: A defender tucks behind a barrier to gain sturdier guard and quicker evasion. It only works while sheltered, and it can also snuff out clinging flames for those trained in the craft.

rites.name: Mianalum
rites.text: A creature's ranged attack that fires a noxious fluid at enemies. It is a natural ability used by a lean, pale hunter-type creature.

rites.name: Vernanum
rites.text: A fierce surge of rage that certain hunting creatures call upon, granting them heightened ferocity in battle. It marks a warrior-beast that thrives in combat and feeds on violence.

rites.name: Nonteror
rites.text: A marksman's trained instinct that lets them seize a fleeting chance to strike a target. It belongs to the archers of a hunting guild.

rites.name: Nialor
rites.text: Nialor is a concept from the Toraizhoth Fall, a bell of shaped stone said to have rung once when the first Shard split from the world. Its meaning is contested, and it is remembered mostly as a sign that the Pact was about to be sworn.

rites.name: Vornes
rites.text: A fighter's measure of how truly their projectiles find the mark when launched. Each rising point adds one percent to the chance of a hit, though close blows and blasts ignore it.

rites.name: Saunastor
rites.text: A trained guardian technique that a support fighter uses to watch over and shield nearby allies from danger during a skirmish.

rites.name: Serallor
rites.text: A mind-crushing craft that lets certain commanders and psychically gifted wardens fill a rival's thoughts with terror until they lose control of themselves.

rites.name: Telilores
rites.text: A trained battle-instinct that lets a fighter of the vanguard guild move with startling speed in moments of danger. It belongs to the shock-troops who lead assaults.

rites.name: Sianeollum
rites.text: A dread-inducing power that certain hulking beings wield to make foes falter. It is shared across two distinct kinds of warrior-creatures.

rites.name: Vornor
rites.text: Warriors spend their full turn of effort to cover greater ground. Some call this the yellow stride, and a prepared strike may follow the sprint.

rites.name: Telaurnires
rites.text: A marksman's focused technique that lets a hunter enter a heightened state of aim. It is practiced by the sharpshooters of a mercenary guild.

rites.name: Riantia
rites.text: A learnable strength of the elect that lets them shift to another place after being wounded. Stripping away protective barriers or armor does not set off this shift.

rites.name: Virnenor
rites.text: Marks are gained by questioning captured foreign beings in the field. Each mark cuts in half the time needed to finish linked crafting and study efforts.

rites.name: Sesor
rites.text: A marksman's craft in which a trained shooter fires into an area to keep foes pinned down and unable to act freely. It belongs to the support specialists of a modern militia.

rites.name: Teosaunia
rites.text: A measure that sets how far a strike or skill can travel and how wide its area of harm spreads. Strikes and skills can carry both a travel distance and a surrounding blast zone.

rites.name: Liarus
rites.text: A stealth technique practiced by a class of wilderness scouts, who vanish from enemies' sight without spending their reserve of effort. It can only be invoked while the scout still has a spark of readiness left.

rites.name: Telesires
rites.text: A training regimen in which each recruit's skill progression is largely left to chance. After the first rank, new abilities are drawn at random from a shared pool, except for those tied to a particular weapon, which stay fixed to their discipline.

rites.name: Mestum
rites.text: A fixed growth pattern raises a fighter's vitality and precision with each rank earned. Optional rules can randomize these gains, and a hidden resolve value can be lost after severe injury.

rites.name: Orauria
rites.text: A specialist fighting role used by one of the operatives in a covert hunting unit. It belongs to a set of roles that such operatives can train into.

rites.name: Telaurnus
rites.text: A hunter's sidearm channels a technique that cannot miss its target. If the strike is fatal, the wielder fades from sight, though this may only be invoked once per expedition.

rites.name: Amernes
rites.text: A lingering toxin that spreads through living flesh after a clawed strike from a hive creature. It lasts until treated or until it claims the victim, and the dead body then sprouts a pod.

rites.name: Orelium
rites.text: A tactic in which one fighter lays down suppressive shots to pin down foes, letting an ally move or act with less risk. It is a skill taught to a supporting role within a squad.

rites.name: Velornus
rites.text: A skill belonging to the marksman trade, a craft in which a hunter gains a way of staying unseen. It is practiced by the sharpshooter's order.

rites.name: Calor
rites.text: A protective energy technique used by armored warriors to soak up incoming harm. It lets the wearer store the force of attacks and convert it into a defensive buffer.

rites.name: Laustiarus
rites.text: A protective ability passed down to a warrior who was once a heavy-armored fighter. It lets the wearer draw on a sturdy, reinforced frame built into their own body.

rites.name: Reonia
rites.text: A trained fighting method used by a front-line soldier who excels at engaging enemies up close. It is one of the specialized techniques a warrior of the assault role can learn.

rites.name: Miastosia
rites.text: A marksman's technique that lets a ranged fighter finish off a weakened foe with a precise shot. It belongs to the sniper's trained repertoire.

rites.name: Ternor
rites.text: A marksman's trained technique for striking a foe so that it loses the ability to act. It is practiced by members of a long-range gunner's guild.

rites.name: Tirnor
rites.text: A battle craft practiced by a specialized front-line fighting class. It lets a warrior of that class strike with sudden, decisive force.

rites.name: Telentirnum
rites.text: A fighting skill belonging to a front-line warrior caste in the invented world. It lets the wielder press into close range and strike with a practiced hand.

rites.name: Lantostus
rites.text: A heavy-soldier technique that lets a fighter launch a rocket-driven leap across a battlefield. It belongs to the armored class of warriors.

rites.name: Viarium
rites.text: A heavy fighter's trained technique that lets them unleash a violent burst of destruction against foes. It belongs to the armored warrior class.

rites.name: Orasor
rites.text: A dazed state that leaves a fighter unable to move or act for the remainder of a skirmish. Companions may haul such a person away, and blasts can still harm them.

rites.name: Casistum
rites.text: A trained reflex that lets a heavily armored warrior answer a sudden threat at once. It belongs to the armored shock troops of a modern militia.

rites.name: Telasia
rites.text: A fighter's chance to turn aside a blow, so that a strike lands only partly and its harm is cut down. Blasts that spread across an area cannot be sidestepped this way.

rites.name: Seristanum
rites.text: A heavy armored soldier's technique that lets a suit-wearing fighter strike with reckless force, where nearby surroundings may be harmed alongside the target.

rites.name: Coronia
rites.text: A passive capability that lets a bearer move up onto any raised surface within reach without a rope or ladder. It activates on its own, needs no recharge, and keeps the bearer hidden as long as no watched tile is crossed.

rites.name: Nolor
rites.text: A battle-hardened fighter's trained ability that drives them to press forward into danger. It belongs to the shock troopers who lead assaults on hostile ground.

rites.name: Maulanum
rites.text: A hovering creature's technique that hurls a target violently into the air. It is wielded by the buoyant drifters of the wild.

rites.name: Orastus
rites.text: A battle technique in which a gunner pins down foes by flooding an area with covering fire. Several kinds of soldiers and machines can learn it, and some trained scouts use a near-identical method.

rites.name: Valiastus
rites.text: A marksman's trained gift that lets a skilled shooter aim through the eyes of allies sharing the same unit. It turns a squad's shared vision into a long-range targeting aid.

rites.name: Cistiarnes
rites.text: A soldier's trained technique that lets a fighter loose a fast burst of shots in one turn. It belongs to the frontline shock troops who rely on close and aggressive engagement.

rites.name: Mellonia
rites.text: A specialist's trained technique that unleashes a rapid flurry of projectiles in a single action. It belongs to the armored heavy soldiers who wield it.

rites.name: Norniasor
rites.text: A specialized discipline open to fighters of any standard training, granting mental powers only to those born with an inner gift revealed by testing. Practitioners are marked by a violet tint on their insignia.

rites.name: Canillium
rites.text: A mental strike that certain ethereal beings can unleash to pierce a foe's mind. Only the most powerful of their kind can wield it.

rites.name: Sistianor
rites.text: A covert craft that lets a band of fighters move unseen among hostile foes. Once the veil is torn, the whole group is exposed and watched closely.

rites.name: Tolistor
rites.text: A condition in which a creature that catches alight suffers twice the harm from its flames. Certain wandering, mindless husks are especially prone to this weakness.

rites.name: Losor Sereolium
rites.text: A restorative craft practised by the aiding caste, used to bring a fallen companion back into the fight. It belongs to the support discipline of the field corps.

rites.name: Cialum
rites.text: A reflexive strike that a soldier can unleash on an enemy during the opponent's turn. It works as a mechanic of the tactical combat system.

rites.name: Tirum
rites.text: A reactive tracking method used by armored suited soldiers. It lets them lock onto threats that move against them.

rites.name: Nausilanum
rites.text: A skill used by trained operatives to take control of enemy machines and secure objectives. Its success depends on the user's cunning against the target's shielding, and some devices can be disabled with special charges.

rites.name: Serausia
rites.text: A tactical discipline that lets a commander slow the flow of a firefight and issue movement or attack orders to allied fighters. The pause gives each comrade a clear target for their weapons or talents.

rites.name: Vaulasum
rites.text: A wearer of a heavy armored harness becomes a solid barrier, sheltering nearby companions from incoming shots. Moving or striking ends the barrier, and the wearer gains no protection for themselves.

rites.name: Laurintanum
rites.text: A heavy soldier's trained skill that lets them hurl explosive canisters with greater precision and force. Later refinements adjusted how the technique works in practice.

rites.name: Seralor
rites.text: A trained fighter who awakens latent mind-powers after a dedicated chamber has been raised. Any novice in the ranks may undergo this instruction to take up the mental arts.

rites.name: Corostanum
rites.text: A chance-based surge in which a strike lands with extra force, rewarding a fighter's skill with a more devastating blow than usual.

rites.name: Corillium
rites.text: A mental discipline that a trained mind channels to rouse and steady its allies. Practitioners of this gift draw on inner focus to spur companions into action.

rites.name: Nantus
rites.text: A trained fighting discipline that lets a frontline warrior endure harm and keep standing. It belongs to the shock troops of a modern defense corps.

rites.name: Coralia
rites.text: A fighter's trained skill that draws the enemy in to them. It belongs to the frontline shock troops of a modern militia.

rites.name: Tiasum
rites.text: A hovering mechanical disc-shaped construct unleashes a violent burst of energy as a signature strike. The technique is one of the methods these machines use to attack their foes.

rites.name: Vaseontum
rites.text: A corrosive affliction that clings to most living and engineered bodies alike. Unlike many lesser ailments, it reaches nearly every kind of creature and machine.

rites.name: Amernium
rites.text: A soldier fitted with a mechanized frame carries a steadying technique passed down from marksmen of an earlier trade. The skill applies only to those who first trained as long-range shooters.

rites.name: Cianium
rites.text: A marksman's technique that lets a trained shooter strike the head of a target for a deadly, precise blow. It belongs to the craft of those who fight from a distance.

rites.name: Coriantor Nillarnus
rites.text: A soldier's stimulant technique that a field medic applies to bolster a companion's strength and endurance during a fight. It is one of the specialized skills a battlefield support caster can learn.

rites.name: Rilanum
rites.text: A soldier's trained method of marking an enemy by projected light so that allies can strike the marked target more reliably. It belongs to the heavy fighters of a modern armed corps.

rites.name: Tenteosia
rites.text: A grasping technique in which a hunter wraps its long limbs around a victim's throat and squeezes until breath fails. It is used by the stalking hunters of the shadowed forests.

rites.name: Cenastes
rites.text: A basic watchful stance that every soldier of the defending forces and most of the strange invaders can hold. It lets a unit hold its fire until an enemy moves into view, then strike back at once.

rites.name: Amintium
rites.text: A tactic that lets a armored war-suit fighter aim for an enemy's weakest, most vital spot. It is a technique used by suit soldiers in the field.

rites.name: Sellium
rites.text: A bloodthirsty pulse that the hulking brute-folk unleash to draw their kin into the fray. Those who hear it are compelled to rush toward the source of the call.

rites.name: Serirnia
rites.text: A marksperson gains a bonus to aim when standing on a spot they have chosen to stay still on. The skill rewards patience and a steady position.

rites.name: Amontaranum
rites.text: A mind-born reserve that a fighter grows as they gain new inner arts and attune a focusing device. It starts at a set base for novices, and some rise higher than others.

rites.name: Valilostus
rites.text: A mental assault that a select few psychic minds can unleash on a foe. Its chance of landing depends on the attacker's inner resolve against the target's, and it ignores shelter, distance, and aim.

rites.name: Ameolles
rites.text: A bent-light barrier that a heavily armored guard can draw from its training. It is passed on to those who first trained as caretakers of wounded companions.

rites.name: Ceostia
rites.text: A bearer's suit lets them spring to any clearly seen spot within a set reach. Using the leap strips away any hiding, and it can be drawn on only a few times per assignment, with a short wait between uses.

rites.name: Oreria
rites.text: A fighter's training that grants a warrior of the frontline corps greater endurance, a bodily discipline of the armored shock troops.

rites.name: Conor
rites.text: A battle-hardened fighter's inner resolve that lets a heavy warrior endure punishment and keep fighting. It is a trained trait belonging to the armored assault ranks.

rites.name: Sasiallum
rites.text: A measure of a fighter's mental fortitude that determines whether a fallen comrade is lost outright or survives bleeding out. Higher resolve grants a greater chance of survival, though no one can reach beyond a certain ceiling.

rites.name: Oriallernes
rites.text: A reserve of protective strength that soaks incoming harm before it reaches a body's vitality. Ordinary blows are softened by it, while piercing strikes pass straight through.

rites.name: Cantum
rites.text: A fighting technique used by a warrior of the assault troop, letting them dash across open ground and fire upon arrival. It belongs to the assault troop's repertoire of battlefield skills.

rites.name: Nireolus
rites.text: A measure of how much harm a fighter can endure before collapsing for good. Fighters can raise this measure through training, ranking, and protective gear, and a near-fallen warrior may sometimes be saved from death.

rites.name: Veontum
rites.text: A trained technique in which a fighter releases a thick, opaque cloud that hides nearby allies from enemy sight. It is taught to support members of a field company.

rites.name: Nostaurus
rites.text: A marksman's technique that lets a shooter fire a second time in a single turn. It belongs to the craft of long-range hunters.

rites.name: Teosor
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by front-line soldiers that lets them drive a hidden foe out of cover. It belongs to the shock troopers who charge into the thick of battle.

rites.name: Amaulanum
rites.text: A trained support fighter can break an opponent's protective barrier and leave them dazed for a short moment. It is a tactical craft used in modern conflict.

rites.name: Amastanum
rites.text: A heavy fighter's special technique that fires a rocket designed to break apart upon impact. It belongs to the armored front-line soldier's repertoire.

rites.name: Tontus
rites.text: A tactical rule lets a fighter take certain moves, shots, or reloads without spending any of their limited turn energy. Some such gifts come with a few uses per encounter or a waiting period before they can be used again.

rites.name: Valorentes
rites.text: A mental condition that leaves a fighter unable to act. Foes with dominating presence can inflict it, and it ends once the source of the affliction is defeated.

rites.name: Minesum
rites.text: A bearer's armor lets them slip through barriers and blockades for a short span, twice in one foray. When they try to cross a ridge or cliff face, they are lifted straight to its crest.

rites.name: Mosteornes
rites.text: A tactic that lets a helper creature cloud the field with dense haze, confusing the eyes of foes. Its craft is later refined to work in a different manner.

rites.name: Nisernum
rites.text: A tactical rule that makes every strike from the side or rear always land a devastating blow. It applies equally to attackers and defenders, reshaping how risky each clash becomes.

rites.name: Siarium
rites.text: A soldier's inner sharpness sets how fast they gather skill points in battle. Covert training raises it, and the raised level also grants back the points earned at that level.

rites.name: Lisus
rites.text: A swift hooked strike that drags one chosen foe up beside the caster, ignoring any cover they hide behind. It can be used again only after a short recharge.

rites.name: Serellanum
rites.text: A soothing vapor that drifts from a war machine's frame, slowly mending the wounds of nearby allied soldiers during a battle.

rites.name: Miarus
rites.text: A learned knack that every operative holds, letting them take over hostile machines by reaching a marked spot. Gifted technicians can often do it from afar with small drone companions.

rites.name: Taustium
rites.text: A scouting role that forward agents take on, using stealth and sharp observation to gather information before the main force moves in.

rites.name: Siantanum
rites.text: A trained practice of battlefield aid that lets a support soldier mend wounded comrades in the middle of a fight. It is a skill bound to the healer's role among a unit's specialists.

rites.name: Meones
rites.text: A trained technique that lets a skilled support fighter move across the field at great speed. It is one of the abilities a support specialist can learn.

rites.name: Amenanum
rites.text: A quality of swift airborne creatures that lets them slip past incoming strikes. Most winged beings of the skies possess this knack for dodging harm.

rites.name: Coresaullor
rites.text: A heavy soldier's craft of launching a propelled explosive from a shoulder-mounted tube. It is a combat skill taught to the armored troops of a modern militia.

rites.name: Mostaria
rites.text: A marksman's trained skill of quick, accurate shooting that belongs to a sniper-type fighter. It is a learned ability used within that specialist's craft.

rites.name: Vaneolanum
rites.text: Each bearer of this craft has two turns of motion per round, and some moves spend both at once. A few swift techniques cost nothing, while certain gifted speakers grant extra turns to allies.

rites.name: Orianor
rites.text: A marksman's technique that lets a hunter fire a shot swiftly and without a full aim. It belongs to the calling of the long-range hunter.

rites.name: Ceranor
rites.text: A trained war-skill of the heavy fighters, letting a soldier unleash a rapid burst of fire across a marked stretch of ground. It is the signature technique of the armored sentinel corps.

rites.name: Teonium
rites.text: A marksman's skill that lets a watcher survey a battlefield for hidden threats. It is a tactical technique belonging to one specialist discipline.

rites.name: Mastes
rites.text: A combat technique used by armored suit pilots to sharpen how they aim and fire their weapons. It belongs to the skill set of heavy mechanized soldiers.

rites.name: Cistum
rites.text: A condition that a living creature acquires, turning it hostile toward its former allies while it lasts. The afflicted creature cannot act until the following turn and cannot seize control of others.

rites.name: Sostor
rites.text: A newly developed combat technique for armored walker suits that fights at close range. Its practitioners train to engage enemies up close with the heavy machines.

rites.name: Vianium
rites.text: A mind-born craft that lets a practitioner bend the unseen force of the air around them into a shielding field. It belongs to the psionic arts of a tightly trained order.

rites.name: Amaurnus
rites.text: A reward of advanced tactical skill that a defending council gains once it claims a distant eastern realm or watches over its four lands from the sky. Its grant comes from either founding the seat of power there at the start or orbiting the region with sentinels later.

rites.name: Maures
rites.text: A far-reaching power that lets certain beings tear open a path through space. Beings of the highest order and one chosen champion can wield it during a climactic battle.

rites.name: Valonesanum
rites.text: A mental craft that lets certain beings seize control of another mind for a time. Commanders, far-seers, and trained adepts all wield it.

rites.name: Caulanum
rites.text: A psychic faculty that lets a being fuse its thoughts with another mind. It belongs to the small grey beings of the outer reaches.

rites.name: Valestilum
rites.text: A mind-siphoning power wielded by the highest tier of a cosmic sentient race, which draws mental energy out of nearby beings. It belongs to the ethereal elite.

rites.name: Tarnerus
rites.text: A surge technique used by mechanical scouts that floods nearby machines with a burst of energy, disrupting their systems.

rites.name: Telalus
rites.text: A psychic rite used by the elders of an alien leadership caste to fuse their minds together. It lets a commander draw on the joined will of its kin.

rites.name: Veolor
rites.text: A passive faculty shared by hovering war engines and elite brute soldiers of an alien host. It lets them unleash a crushing barrage without being prompted, shaping how their squads fight.

rites.name: Rastor
rites.text: A sudden shift of position that carries a being across space in an instant. Watchers aiming at the one who moves find their aim unreliable while it stays within their line of sight.

rites.name: Telarnes
rites.text: A natural resistance that certain alien kinds carry, leaving them unaffected by disabling shocks that would otherwise overwhelm their bodies.
